title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
lineage: Master Reel (Teac A-6100) -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Fostex FR-2LE -> WAV (24bit/96k)  Mastering Info: WAV -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Shure Line Mixers -> Advent Advocate Dolby B Unit -> Master Reel (Sony Deck - BASF Tapes - 1/4 Track - 7 1/2 ips)

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 show, highlighted by monster jams on Hard to Handle, Alligator and Dark Hollow, with crystal‑clear mix that finally brings Pigpen’s organ forward.
ai_review.review: The April ’71 performance is consistently described as one of the band’s all‑time greats, featuring soaring jams (notably the pre‑Goin’ Down The Road jam, Hard to Handle and a rare electric Dark Hollow) and a high‑octane energy that kept the crowd buzzing. Charlie Miller’s 16‑track soundboard mix is praised for its clarity, excellent stereo separation and the unprecedented audibility of Pigpen’s organ throughout the set. Overall both the music and the recording are judged exceptional, with only a few minor critiques about occasional balance issues.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (10 out of 13) rate the show 5 stars and praise both performance and mix; only a few lower scores cite minor mixing concerns, yielding an overall weighted rating around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean soundboard capture with perfect stereo separation; Charlie Miller’s patch work restores audience patches and lifts Pigpen’s organ throughout. Reviewers note a “monster upgrade” of the mix, minimal drop‑outs, and overall superb clarity.

standout_songs: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad (jam before it)
show_quality.setlist_flow: An attractive set list that balances concise, composed numbers with expansive jams; the second half builds momentum with a blissful post‑Cryptical jam and a powerful Alligator finale.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for soaring guitar work, flawless tone on Dark Hollow, Ripple and overall harmonizing throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is unusually front‑and‑center and audible across most songs; reviewers commend the improved keyboard presence in this 16‑track mix.
